description: Free. Returns one framework in full: its rule, its trap, its text, the run_* tools that put sourced numbers behind each step (with the question each answers), a real published case with its date, and where it is used. Use it to apply the framework to the user's situation step by step.

slug.description: The framework's slug or name, e.g. "the-monocrop", "monocrop", "signal-noise-split". From list_frameworks.

name: get_framework
title: Read one CULT+MATH framework
